data.name: Anisaat
data.gender_notes: Anisaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who keeps the gardens, or the one who gives good news and comfort to others. The name Anisaat carries the meaning “Gardener, giver of good news” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Anisaat usually hope their child will grow to embody gardener, giver of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes nurturing and care for the garden of one's soul
data.etymology: Anisaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gardener, giver of good news.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anisaat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: أنيسات
in_arabic.meaning: أنيسات هي جمع أنيسة، يعني الودود، الحبيبة، الصديقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أنيسات هو جمع مؤنث سالم من أنيسة، ويعني الودود الحبيبة الصديقة. اشتقت هذه الكلمة من الأنس، أي الود والصفاء، ومن الجدير بالذكر أن هذا الاسم يحمل دلالات عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالمحبة والتواصل الإنساني الودود. كما أن الاسم يوحي بالراحة والاطمئنان عند التفاعل مع الشخص الحامل لهذا الاسم.

in_urdu.name: انیسات
in_urdu.long_meaning: انیسات ایک عربی نام ہے جو کہ انیسة کی جمع ہے۔ انیسة کا مطلب ہوتا ہے دوست، پیاری یا محبوب۔ یہ نام دوست کے مفہوم سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا تعلق انسان کے جذبات اور محبت سے ہے۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، انیسات جیسے ناموں کو اہمیت دی جاتی ہے کیونکہ وہ محبت، تعلق اور انسانی رابطے کی عکاسی کرتے ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، انیسات جیسے نام لڑکیوں کے لئے ایک خوبصورت اور معنی خیز انتخاب ہو سکتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: अनीसात
in_hindi.meaning: अनीसात यह नाम अनीसा का ही एक रूप है, अर्थात मित्र, प्रिय, प्यारी
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनीसात नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और यह अनीसा का बहुवचन रूप है। इसका अर्थ होता है मित्र, प्रिय या प्यारी। यह नाम दोस्ती और स्नेह की भावना से जुड़ा हुआ है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, अनीसात जैसे नामों का चयन इसलिए किया जाता है क्योंकि वे प्रेम, संबंध और मानवीय जुड़ाव को दर्शाते हैं।

in_pashto.name: انیسات
in_pashto.long_meaning: د انیسات نوم معنی د انیسة جمع دی، چی د دوستۍ، ګرانوالي، او مینې څخه مشتق شوی دی. دا نوم د انس له کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چی د تودوخ او موافقې معنی ورکوي. په افغان او پښتون کلتور کې، دا ډول نومونه د خپلمنځي اړیکو او مینې د څرګندولو لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Anisaat
in_english.long_meaning: The name Anisaat is the plural form of Anisa, derived from the Arabic root 'ansa', which means to feel comfortable or to befriend. It translates to friendly, beloved, or dear ones. In Islamic tradition, names like Anisaat carry significant meanings related to interpersonal relationships and affection. Historically, such names have been used to express warmth and companionship. The name symbolizes positive personality traits such as being sociable, affectionate, and amiable. Across Muslim cultures, Anisaat is chosen for its beautiful connotation and rich cultural heritage.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anisaat can be traced back to the Arabic word "anis", which means "gardener". In the Islamic context, the name carries a cultural significance as a symbol of beauty, growth, and nurturing. Anisaat can be seen as someone who cares for the environment, metaphorically or literally, and follows in the footsteps of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), who is known for encouraging Muslims to plant gardens and maintain them.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Anisaat symbolizes comfort, support, encouragement, and good news. The root words of the name, "anis" and "anisat" in Arabic, imply constantly giving and providing comfort and solace to others. An Isa in the Islamic tradition also refers to the Prophet Ibrahim’s wife Hajar, who was proven to be a source of comfort and protection for her son Ishmael in the desert. Thus, Anisaat is a name that carries a soothing, nurturing, and supportive meaning, reminding the bearer and those around them that they too can be a source of comfort and good news to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gardener, giver of good news" symbolizes The one who keeps the gardens, or the one who gives good news and comfort to others. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Anisaat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gardener, giver of good news.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Anisaat bint Abdul-Muttalib, daughter of Abdul-Muttalib, was the wife of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Anisaat carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Anisaat was one of the wives of the Prophet Muhammad and is mentioned in various Hadiths.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Anisaat remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
